arxiv-2111-05343.title: Inflow of low-metallicity cool gas in the halo of the Andromeda galaxy 2021 Inflow of low-metallicity cool gas in the halo of the Andromeda galaxy – A
arxiv-2111-05343.creator: Andrea Afruni, Gabriele Pezzulli & Filippo Fraternali
arxiv-2111-05343.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Andrea Afruni, Gabriele Pezzulli & Filippo Fraternali. As the closest L ∗ L^{\ast} galaxy to our own Milky Way, the Andromeda galaxy (M31) is an ideal laboratory for studies of galaxy evolution. The AMIGA project has recently provided observations of the cool ( T ∼ 10 4 T\sim 10^{4} K) phase of the circumgalactic medium (CGM) of M31, using HST/COS absorption spectra along ∼ 40 \sim 40 background QSO sightlines, located up to and beyond the galaxy virial radius.

arxiv-2111-11694.title: MARS via LASSO
arxiv-2111-11694.description: Abstract Multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS) is a popular method for nonparametric regression introduced by Friedman in 1991. MARS fits simple nonlinear and non-additive functions to regression data. We propose and study a natural lasso variant of the MARS method.

arxiv-2203-09183.title: RoMe: A Robust Metric for Evaluating Natural Language Generation
arxiv-2203-09183.creator: Md Rashad Al Hasan Rony, Liubov Kovriguina, Debanjan Chaudhuri, Ricardo Usbeck, Jens Lehmann
arxiv-2203-09183.description: Abstract Evaluating Natural Language Generation (NLG) systems is a challenging task. Firstly, the metric should ensure that the generated hypothesis reflects the reference’s semantics. Secondly, it should consider the grammatical quality of the generated sentence. Thirdly, it should be robust enough to handle various surface forms of the generated sentence. Thus, an effective evaluation metric has to be multifaceted.

arxiv-2307-07395.description: Abstract Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are being used for wireless communications in smart environments. However, the need for mobility, scalability of data transmission over wide areas, and the required coverage area make UAV beamforming essential for better coverage and user experience.

arxiv-2308-07279.title: A Robust Image Forensic Framework Utilizing Multi-Colorspace Enriched Vision Transformer for Distinguishing Natural and Computer-Generated Images
arxiv-2308-07279.creator: Manjary P. Gangan, Anoop Kadan, Lajish V. L
arxiv-2308-07279.description: Abstract The digital image forensics based research works in literature classifying natural and computer generated images primarily focuses on binary tasks. These tasks typically involve the classification of natural images versus computer graphics images only or natural images versus GAN generated images only, but not natural images versus both types of generated images simultaneously.

arxiv-2309-14234.title: Mitigating Worst-Case Exozodiacal Dust Structure in High-contrast Images of Earth-like Exoplanets Journal: AJ
arxiv-2309-14234.creator: Miles H. Currie, Christopher C. Stark, Jens Kammerer, Roser Juanola-Parramon, Victoria S. Meadows
arxiv-2309-14234.description: Abstract Detecting Earth-like exoplanets in direct images of nearby Sun-like systems brings a unique set of challenges that must be addressed in the early phases of designing a space-based direct imaging mission. In particular, these systems may contain exozodiacal dust, which is expected to be the dominant source of astrophysical noise.

pmc-10647667.title: Radiologic Progression of Interstitial Lung Abnormalities following Surgical Resection in Patients with Lung Cancer
pmc-10647667.creator: Yoon Joo Shin, Jeong Geun Yi, Mi Young Kim, Donghee Son, Su Yeon Ahn, Eugenio Pompeo
pmc-10647667.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In this study, we aimed to assess the prevalence of interstitial lung abnormalities (ILAs) and investigate the rates and risk factors associated with radiologic ILA progression among patients with lung cancer following surgical resection. Patients who underwent surgical resection for lung cancer at our institution from January 2015 to December 2020 were retrospectively evaluated and grouped according to their ILA status as having no ILAs, equivocal ILAs, or ILAs.

pmc-10685081.title: Assessment Scales in Cerebral Palsy: A Comprehensive Review of Tools and Applications
pmc-10685081.creator: Chaitanya Kumar Javvaji, Jayant D Vagha, Revat J Meshram, Amar Taksande
pmc-10685081.description: Cerebral palsy (CP) is a complex neurological condition characterized by motor dysfunction affecting millions worldwide. This comprehensive review delves into the critical role of assessment in managing CP. Beginning with exploring its definition and background, we elucidate the diverse objectives of CP assessment, ranging from diagnosis and goal setting to research and epidemiology.

pmc-10749459.creator: Zhengqi Wu, Mingyue Jin, Peng Xin, Hao Zhang
pmc-10749459.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundModulation of programmed cell death in tumor cells alters the tumor microenvironment and the influx of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and the combination of its inducers and immune checkpoint inhibitors plays a synergistic role in enhancing antitumor effects.MethodsWe downloaded the data of clear cell renal cell carcinoma samples from The Cancer Genome Atlas and used a machine learning approach to build a new programmed cell death index (PCDI) through 13 programmed cell death-related genes.

pmc-10898908.title: Paediatric fibrosarcoma treatment
pmc-10898908.creator: Adrián Cano-Padilla, Augusto Ramírez, Paola Cervantes-Rivera, Rosalba Bellido-Magaña, Gilberto Flores-Vargas, Nicolás Padilla-Raygoza
pmc-10898908.description: IntroductionSoft tissue sarcomas make up 7%–15% of childhood solid tumours. The aetiology of this disease is unknown. It is a fast-growing, painless tumour; histologically similar to adult fibrosarcoma, but having a lesser risk of metastasis and a better prognosis. The treatment is aimed towards localised intervention; complete surgical resection is the appropriate treatment as long as it can be performed.

pmc-11474622.title: How dry is dead? Evaluating the impact of desiccation on the viability of the invasive species Cissus quadrangularis
pmc-11474622.creator: Ariadna Mondragón‐Botero, Jennifer S Powers
pmc-11474622.description: Cissus quadrangularis is a succulent vine that degrades forests where it is not native by growing over trees and causing them to break or by impeding regeneration. Methods for its control have been tried but no satisfactory approach has been found yet.

pmc-12611305.title: Glans tunnel‐based reconstruction with skin flap or lip mucosa graft for distal penile urethral strictures
pmc-12611305.creator: Fuhao Ji, Lin Wang, Tong Zhao, Yidong Liu, Xiangguo Lyu
pmc-12611305.description: PurposeThe aim of this study is to evaluate the clinical efficacy of glans tunnel urethroplasty using a pedicled penile flap or lower lip mucosa for glans penis urethral stricture.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted on 41 patients with urethral stricture at the glans penis who visited our hospital from January 2021 to July 2025.

pmc-12648930.title: A qualitative study in Rwamagana District, Rwanda, on the acceptability and utilisation of sexual and reproductive services in youth corners
pmc-12648930.creator: Peace Iraguha, Nomzamo Thembelihle Siyaya Ncube, Tsion Yohannes
pmc-12648930.description: BackgroundTeenage pregnancies remain a pressing issue in Sub-Saharan Africa, including Rwanda. Adolescent girls and young women (AGYW) continue to face a myriad of challenges in accessing sexual reproductive health (SRH) services. This study examines the accessibility and utilization of SRH services provided to AGYW in youth corners in Rwamagana district, Rwanda.

pmc-13012808.title: Selective Visualization of Type II Collagen Using Sum‐Frequency Generation (SFG)
pmc-13012808.creator: Salile Khandani, Yryx Y Luna Palacios, Hannah Savage, Luis Chavez, Eric O Potma
pmc-13012808.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Collagen Types I and II share highly conserved triple‐helical backbones and similar C—H stretch vibrational spectra, which limits the ability of conventional spectroscopic or second‐harmonic generation methods to unambiguously distinguish between them in native and engineered matrices.

pmc-13297485.title: Application of Metal–Organic Framework-Based Electrochemiluminescence Sensors for Mycotoxin Detection in Food
pmc-13297485.creator: Tong Zhang, Xinyu Chen, Qiangqiang Wang, Shuyue Xing, Dan Wu
pmc-13297485.description: Mycotoxins are toxic secondary metabolites produced by filamentous fungi, which extensively contaminate agricultural products such as grains and nuts. Common mycotoxins, including aflatoxin B1, ochratoxin A, and deoxynivalenol, can induce liver cancer, kidney damage, neural tube defects, and immune suppression, necessitating highly sensitive detection methods to ensure food safety. Conventional techniques are limited by complex procedures and insufficient sensitivity.

pmc-13402526.title: The subacromial bursa in rotator cuff injury: from pathological contributor to regenerative resource?
pmc-13402526.creator: Xiong Wang, Qing Gu, Feifei Zhang, Lu Li, Jinqiang Zhang, Wenqiang Wei, Shuming Zi, Song Chen
pmc-13402526.description: Rotator cuff injury (RCI) represents a leading cause of shoulder pain and functional impairment, imposing a considerable burden on patients’ quality of life and healthcare systems worldwide. The subacromial bursa (SAB), a critical anatomical structure located between the acromion and rotator cuff tendons, has traditionally been regarded as a primary pathological contributor to pain generation, inflammation, and tendon degeneration.
